svg.aria-label: Mental state, capacity, risk, and common syndromes

g.text: A label does not determine capacity
Begin with what happened, why now,
Explains this person, not a list
Specific to the decision and time
An unwise choice does not prove
Delusion matters only if it blocks
Asking does not implant the idea
Not a promise or no-suicide contract
Low mood or loss of interest with
Eating disorders occur at any body
